overview.title: Overview
overview.description: All your F-Droid repositories at a glance.

empty.title: No repository yet
empty.description: Import a repository you already have, or create a new one. Your existing keys, apps and settings are kept as they are.
empty.descriptionMember: No repository has been shared with you yet. Ask an administrator.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Publications, changes and their results, for every repository.

empty.title: Nothing happened yet
empty.description: Every publication and every change will be listed here, with who did it and how it went.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Automatic follows the setting of your device and changes with it.

accent.title: Accent color
accent.description: Buttons, links and highlights all derive from this color. Text stays readable whatever you choose.
accent.adminOnly: The accent color is shared by the whole panel and set by an administrator.

language.title: Language
language.description: Automatic uses the language of your browser, or English if it is not available.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This address does not match any page of the panel.

about.description: A self-hosted dashboard to manage F-Droid repositories from a browser.
about.notAffiliated: F-Droid Panel is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by the F-Droid project.
about.builtWith: Repositories are built and signed by fdroidserver, from the F-Droid project. Icons by Tabler Icons.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Welcome back. Sign in to manage your repositories.
login.secondFactorDescription: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for F-Droid Panel.
login.codeHint: Lost your phone? Type one of your recovery codes instead.

setup.title: Create the administrator account
setup.description: This is the first visit. Use the setup code shown at the end of the installation to create the main account.
setup.codeHint: Printed by the installer. On the server, "fdroid-panel setup-code" prints a new one.
setup.usernameHint: What you type to sign in. Lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.
setup.passwordHint: Used with the username to sign in. At least 10 characters: a short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
setup.displayNameHint: Only shown in the panel, for example in the activity log. Any name you like.

reauth.title: Confirm it is you
reauth.description: For this sensitive action, type your password again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.pictureHint: A photo or an image; its middle is kept, as a square.
profile.pictureUnreadable: This image cannot be read. Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing it signs you out everywhere else.
password.changedDescription: Your other sessions were signed out.

secondFactor.title: Two-step verification
secondFactor.description: Asks for a code from your phone at each sign in. Strongly recommended, as the panel is reachable from the Internet.
secondFactor.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone (Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator…).
secondFactor.step2: Scan this QR code with it, or type the key below.
secondFactor.qrLabel: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
secondFactor.codesDescription: Each code works once, if you lose your phone. They are shown only now: download them or write them down.
secondFactor.disableDescription: Your account will be protected by its password only.

sessions.title: Signed in devices
sessions.description: Sign out a device you do not recognize or no longer use.

roles.adminDescription: Everything: every repository, users, settings and the panel itself.
roles.maintainerDescription: Adds and edits apps and publishes, in the repositories assigned to them.
roles.viewerDescription: Sees the repositories assigned to them, without changing anything.

users.title: Users
users.description: People who can sign in to this panel, and what they are allowed to do.
users.passwordDescription: Give it to them privately; they can change it in their account settings.
users.temporaryPasswordHint: At least 10 characters. They can change it after signing in.
users.deleteDescription: The account is removed. The history keeps their name.
users.resetSecondFactorDescription: They will sign in with their password only, until they enable it again.
users.noRepositories: No repository yet: add one first, then come back to give access.

fdroid.title: fdroidserver
fdroid.description: The official F-Droid tool the panel uses to build and sign the repositories.

errors.networkError: The panel cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unexpectedError: Something went wrong on the server. The details are in the service log.
errors.notAuthenticated: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.csrf: The request was refused for security reasons. Reload the page and try again.
errors.notFound: This item does not exist anymore.
errors.invalidSecondFactor: This code is not valid. Check the time of your phone if it keeps happening.
errors.invalidSetupCode: This setup code is not valid or has expired. Print a new one with "fdroid-panel setup-code" on the server.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Wait {{minutes}} minutes and try again.
errors.reauthenticationRequired: Please confirm your password to continue.
errors.lastAdmin: There must always be at least one active administrator.
errors.cannotDisableSelf: You cannot disable your own account.
errors.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own account.
errors.userNotFound: This user does not exist anymore.
errors.repositoryNotFound: This repository does not exist anymore.
errors.jobNotFound: This operation does not exist anymore.
errors.invalidUsername: Use lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores (2 to 32 characters).
errors.passwordTooShort: The password must have at least 10 characters.
errors.interrupted: The service stopped while this operation was running. Nothing was published by it; run it again.
errors.commandFailed: {{command}} failed (exit code {{exit_code}}). The log shows what happened.
errors.commandTimeout: {{command}} took more than {{minutes}} minutes and was stopped.
errors.fdroidNotFound: fdroidserver is not installed at {{command}}. Run the installer again, option Repair.
errors.fdroidNotRunnable: fdroidserver at {{command}} does not start. Run the installer again, option Repair.
errors.selfTestNotPublished: fdroidserver ran but did not publish the test app. The log shows what happened.
errors.invalidSlug: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
errors.slugTaken: Another repository already uses this identifier.
errors.urlPrefixTaken: Another repository already uses this address.
errors.repositoryAlreadyRegistered: This repository is already in the panel.
errors.pathNotAbsolute: Give the full path, starting with /.
errors.pathNotFound: This folder does not exist on the server.
errors.notARepository: No config.yml in this folder: it is not an F-Droid repository.
errors.notWritable: The panel cannot write in this folder. Run the installer again and choose Repair, or fix the permissions.
errors.repoUrlInvalid: repo_url in config.yml must end with /repo.
errors.keystoreMissing: The signing key named in config.yml is missing.
errors.keystoreReadableByOthers: Other users of the server can read the signing key. Restricting its permissions is recommended.
errors.indexNotWritten: fdroidserver did not write the index. The previous one was put back.
errors.indexNotSigned: The index has no valid signature. The previous one was put back.
errors.signingKeyChanged: The index was signed by another key than before, which phones would refuse. Nothing was published: the previous index was put back.
errors.nothingToRollBack: There is no previous publication to restore.
errors.accessAccountNotFound: This access does not exist anymore.
errors.appNotFound: This app is not in the repository anymore.
errors.versionNotFound: This version does not exist anymore.
errors.uploadNotFound: This file is not waiting anymore. Add it again.
errors.uploadNotReady: This file cannot be added yet, or the repository changed since it was checked. Add it again.
errors.uploadOffset: The transfer got out of step. It resumes by itself.
errors.uploadTooLarge: The file is bigger than announced, or bigger than 2 GB.
errors.uploadFailed: The file could not be sent: {{reason}}
errors.bundleNotSupported: App bundles (AAB, APKS, XAPK) cannot be published by F-Droid. Use an APK file.
errors.notAnApk: This is not a valid APK file.
errors.noVersionCode: This APK has no version number.
errors.notSigned: This APK is not signed, or its signature is broken. F-Droid only publishes signed APKs.
errors.signerMismatch: This APK is signed with another key than the previous versions of the app. F-Droid would refuse it, and phones could not update.
errors.versionExists: Version {{version}} of this app is already in the repository.
errors.olderVersion: This version is older than {{latest}}, the newest one in the repository. Phones will not install it as an update.
errors.newPermissions: This version asks for new permissions: {{permissions}}.
errors.invalidPackage: This is not a valid app identifier.
errors.invalidLocale: This is not a valid language code.
errors.invalidField: This field cannot be changed here.
errors.invalidAntiFeature: This warning is not known by F-Droid.
errors.invalidGraphic: This kind of image is not known by F-Droid.
errors.invalidScreenshotType: This kind of screenshot is not known by F-Droid.
errors.screenshotNotFound: This screenshot does not exist anymore.
errors.screenshotsChanged: The screenshots changed in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
errors.imageTooLarge: The image is too large (8 MB at most).
errors.unsupportedImage: Use a PNG or JPEG image of at most 8192 pixels per side.
errors.summaryTooLong: The short description is too long.
errors.maintenanceUnavailable: This server has no maintenance helper. Use install.sh on the server.
errors.downloadFailed: The new version could not be downloaded or did not pass its checksum.
errors.installFailed: The installation of the new files failed. Nothing changed; the log shows why.
errors.rolledBack: The new version did not start: the previous version and its database were put back.
errors.rollbackFailed: The new version did not start and going back failed too. Run install.sh on the server, option Repair.
errors.notInstalled: The panel is not installed with install.sh on this server.
errors.pathNotAllowed: This folder cannot be handed over to the panel (system folder, or files linked from elsewhere).
errors.failed: The operation failed. The log shows why.
errors.iconNotPng: The logo must be a PNG image.
errors.keyNotFound: This key does not exist anymore.

publish.title: Publish {{name}}
publish.description: Builds and signs the index with fdroidserver, so F-Droid clients see the changes.
publish.nothingPending: No change is waiting. Publishing again rebuilds the index from the files, which also picks up changes made outside the panel.
publish.leftOut_one: {{count}} APK was left out of the index
publish.leftOut_other: {{count}} APKs were left out of the index

reason.signerNotAllowed: signed by another key than the previous versions
reason.noMetadata: no information about this app yet

newRepository.title: Add a repository
newRepository.description: Take over a repository you already have, or start a new one.
newRepository.name: Name
newRepository.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Used in addresses and folder names.
newRepository.addressHint: This is the address phones use. It cannot change later without breaking the phones that added it.
newRepository.useRoot: Use the main address (no identifier in it)
newRepository.archiveHint: Versions beyond this number move to the archive, which F-Droid shows separately.
newRepository.archiveNever: Keep every version in the repository
newRepository.archiveKeep_one: Keep the latest version, archive the others
newRepository.archiveKeep_other: Keep the {{count}} latest versions, archive the others
newRepository.privateHint: Phones need a user name and password, which you create in the Access tab.

import.choiceDescription: You already have an F-Droid repository on this server. Its keys, apps and address stay exactly as they are.
import.title: Where is the repository?
import.description: The folder that contains config.yml. Nothing is changed until you confirm.
import.pathHint: For example /srv/fdroid. The panel only reads it at this step.
import.movePasswords: Move the keystore passwords out of config.yml
import.movePasswordsHint: They are stored in a file only the panel can read. A copy of config.yml is kept first.
import.safe: The address, the signing key and the apps do not change: phones that use this repository keep working.
import.grant: Give the panel access to this folder
import.grantHint: The server hands the folder over to the panel's system user and protects its keystore. Nothing else changes.

create.choiceDescription: The panel creates the folder, the signing key and the configuration, then publishes it.
create.title: New repository
create.description: A signing key is generated for it. Keep the panel backups: the key cannot be recreated.
create.runningDescription: fdroidserver generates the signing key and publishes a first, empty index.

checks.writable: The panel can write in it

share.title: Add this repository to F-Droid
share.description: Send this link or show this QR code: the F-Droid app adds the repository and checks its signature.
share.private: This repository is private: phones need an access, created in the Access tab. Your panel account does not work there. Share the link or QR code shown when the access is created: it contains its username and password.
share.linkHint: Contains the fingerprint, so the F-Droid app can verify it is the right repository.
share.fingerprintHint: F-Droid shows it in the repository details. It never changes, unless the signing key is replaced.
share.qr: QR code to add the repository
share.qrHint: Scan it from the F-Droid app, or with the phone camera.

access.title: Access accounts
access.description: Each phone or person gets its own user name and password, which you can remove at any time.
access.notPrivate: This repository is public: these accounts are only used once it is made private, in Settings.
access.addDescription: Choose a password or let the panel generate one. You can show it again later, with a link and a QR code ready to share.
access.label: Name
access.labelHint: Who or what it is for, such as “Marie’s phone”.
access.createdDescription: Share the link or the QR code with the phone: they contain the username and the password.
access.removeDescription: The F-Droid app using it will stop receiving updates from this repository.
access.emptyDescription: Create one access per phone or per person.
access.usernameHint: What the phone signs in with. Leave empty to use the name above.
access.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Leave empty and a strong password is generated for you.
access.changeDescription: The phone that uses this access must then be given the new password.
access.passwordUnknown: This access was created before the panel kept passwords, so its password cannot be shown. Give it a new one: it can be shown at any time afterwards.

repositorySettings.generalDescription: Shown in the F-Droid app. Changes appear after the next publication.
repositorySettings.savedDescription: Publish to send them to the phones.
repositorySettings.autoPublishHint: Every change is published right away, without pressing Publish.
repositorySettings.privateHint: Phones need an access account to read the repository.
repositorySettings.rollbackHint: Puts back the index as it was before the last publication.
repositorySettings.rollbackDescription: Phones will see the repository as it was before the last publication, until the next one.
repositorySettings.removeHint: The files stay in {{path}} and keep working with the command line.
repositorySettings.removeDescription: Nothing is deleted on disk: the keystore passwords are put back into config.yml so the repository works without the panel.
repositorySettings.removed: The repository was removed from the panel
repositorySettings.iconDescription: Shown by F-Droid apps next to the repository name. A square PNG image, 512 × 512 is ideal.

apps.emptyDescription: Add your first app by dropping its APK file here. The panel reads it, checks its signature and prepares its page.
apps.emptyReadOnly: Nobody has added an app to this repository yet.
apps.dropHint: or click to choose them. Up to 2 GB each.
apps.dropOverlay: Drop to add these APK files
apps.dropAnywhere: You can also drop APK files anywhere on this page.

uploads.title: Files being added
uploads.sameSigner: Same signing key as the previous versions.
uploads.added: Added. It will be visible in F-Droid after the next publication.
uploads.name: Name
uploads.summaryHint: One line shown under the name.

app.notFound: This app is not in the repository anymore.
app.savedDescription: Publish the repository to show it in F-Droid.

languages.title: Languages
languages.addDescription: The texts and images of this language are shown to people whose phone uses it. The others see English.
languages.removeDescription: Its texts, images and screenshots are removed. A copy is kept in the backups.

texts.title: Texts
texts.description: What people read in F-Droid before installing the app.
texts.name: Name
texts.descriptionHint: Leave an empty line between paragraphs.
texts.legacy: Some texts of this app are written in its main file and are shown in every language. Saving texts moves them to English, so each language can have its own.

graphics.title: Images
graphics.description: PNG or JPEG. The recommended size is shown next to each image.
graphics.removeDescription: A copy is kept in the backups.

screenshots.title: Screenshots
screenshots.description: Drag them to change their order. PNG or JPEG.

versions.title: Versions
versions.description: Every APK file of this app. To publish an update, add the APK of the new version: same app, a higher version number, signed with the same key.
versions.none: This app has no APK file. Add one from the apps list.
versions.removeDescription: The APK file is moved to the backups. Phones that installed it keep it, but it is not offered anymore after the next publication.
versions.signerDescription: New versions must be signed with this key, so nobody can replace the app with a fake one.

details.author: Author and license
details.antiFeaturesDescription: F-Droid shows these warnings before people install the app.
details.removeHint: Removes every version, text and image of this app.
details.removeDescription: All its files are moved to the backups. Phones that installed it keep it, but it is not offered anymore after the next publication.

tracking.title: Tracking
tracking.description: The app records or reports what people do.

nonFreeNet.title: Non-free network services
nonFreeNet.description: The app relies on a service whose code is not free.

nonFreeAdd.title: Non-free add-ons
nonFreeAdd.description: The app promotes non-free apps or add-ons.

nonFreeDep.title: Non-free dependencies
nonFreeDep.description: The app needs a non-free app to work.

nonFreeAssets.title: Non-free assets
nonFreeAssets.description: Some images, sounds or data are not free.

upstreamNonFree.title: Non-free upstream
upstreamNonFree.description: The original version contains non-free code.

tetheredNet.title: Tethered network service
tetheredNet.description: The app only works with a server run by its author.

nsfw.title: Adult content
nsfw.description: The app contains content not suitable for everyone.

knownVuln.title: Known vulnerability
knownVuln.description: The app has a known security issue.

disabledAlgorithm.title: Weak signature
disabledAlgorithm.description: The app is signed with an algorithm considered weak.

noSourceSince.title: Source code no longer available
noSourceSince.description: The source code of recent versions is not published.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: The categories apps can be placed in, with the name F-Droid shows.
categories.name: Name of {{id}}
categories.inUse: Used by apps, remove it from them first.

maintenance.title: Updates
maintenance.cardDescription: New versions of the panel are installed by the server itself, with an automatic return to the current version if anything fails.
maintenance.unavailable: On this server, the panel is updated with install.sh (option Update).
maintenance.description: The server does this in the background. The panel may restart for a few seconds.
maintenance.confirmDescription: The panel stops for a few seconds. Its database is backed up first, and if the new version does not start, the current one comes back by itself. Repositories are not touched.

sessions.title: Sign-in
sessions.description: How long you stay signed in, and how often the panel asks for your password again before sensitive actions (updates, accesses, users). Applies to every account.

keys.title: Automatic upload
keys.description: Keys let a build script, such as Android Studio, add new versions to this repository by itself. A key acts for the account that created it and can do nothing else.
keys.emptyDescription: Create one to send new versions from your builds without opening the panel.
keys.name: Name
keys.nameHint: Where it is used, for example the name of your computer.
keys.canPublishHint: The repository is published as soon as a version arrives with this key, even when automatic publishing is off. Versions you add yourself keep following the repository setting.
keys.addDescription: It can only add versions to this repository.
keys.createdDescription: Copy it now: it is shown only once. Anyone who has it can add versions to this repository.
keys.properties: To paste in the local.properties or keystore.properties file of your Android project, which you never share:
keys.guide: How to set up the build
keys.removeDescription: Builds that use it can no longer add versions. This cannot be undone.
